acceptanceCriteria: The owner decides the scope; the spec and package.json configuration scope agree with the decision.
body: Found by the 2026-09-27 adapter audit for rc.2. extensions/vscode/src/liveTests.ts:109 reads liveTests.enabled per resource, so a folder-level .vscode/settings.json in a trusted workspace can turn on process spawning for that folder. Decide whether spawning consent should be machine or window scope only, as restrictedConfigurations suggests.
title: Should corvint.liveTests.enabled be window-scoped rather than resource-scoped
